CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), organization (coordinate pattern/row-column mapping) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color labels) bound to coordinates are listed.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status metadata entries accompany content identifiers, distinguishing content from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented (coordinate mappings and explicit row/column orientation) for current and candidate referents.
